findings.correction: Some collapsed. Others knocked the shots aside. The ones who fell did not get up again.
findings.current:
Some people collapsed. Others were knocked backward.

But the ones who fell did not get up again.
findings.defect: 튕겨 냈다 is an active deflection of the projectiles, not the victims being knocked backward. The line contrasts those who fall with those who bat the shots away.
findings.rationale: Misreading 튕겨 냈다 as 튕겨 나갔다 reverses who acts and who is hit; only the fallen stay down.
findings.source: 누군가는 쓰러지고, 누군가는 튕겨 냈다. 그러나 쓰러진 자들은 다시 일어나지 못했다.

findings.defect: 펼쳐 here deploys the encircling formation (they then close in). Spread out is the chapter’s wording for 산개/거리 벌려 and reverses the tactic.
findings.rationale: Next sentence has the squad tightening from all sides; this is not a dispersal order.

findings.correction: I answered, pretending to be calm.
findings.current: I answered as calmly as I could.
findings.defect: 척 is feigned composure, not effortful genuine calm.
findings.rationale: Taekyung is bluffing the Head Elder; dropping the pretence changes characterization.

findings.current: “Old man, does it still get up?”
findings.defect: 고추 is a crude chili/pepper euphemism; the English drops the image and makes the sexual meaning more direct.
findings.rationale: The Sword Energy then standing 우뚝 is the punchline on 서요; keep the euphemism.

findings.correction: I snatched terrified Hyuk by the scruff of the neck.
findings.defect: 목덜미 is the nape/scruff; neck can read as the throat. 공포에 질린 modifies Hyuk, not the neck.
findings.rationale: He yanks Hyuk out of the cut so he can run, not seizes his throat.
findings.source: 나는 공포에 질린 혁무진의 목덜미를 잡아챘다.

findings.correction: Jin Wikyung, appearing like a savior, winked at me.
findings.current: The savior who had appeared like a deus ex machina winked at me.
findings.defect: Adds deus ex machina; source is only like a savior.
findings.rationale: Fidelity forbids imported meta framing and extra literary coloring.
findings.source: 구세주처럼 나타난 진위경이 나를 향해 눈을 찡긋했다.

findings.correction: The likes of you, stopping me?
findings.current: You think you can stop me?
findings.defect: 따위 (the likes of you) is the Head Elder’s contempt; the gloss is a plain challenge.
findings.rationale: Hierarchy and scorn are the point of 네가? unpacked in narration.
findings.source: 너 따위가 날 막을 수 있겠냐. 그런 뜻이겠지.

findings.correction: “Heh heh. What a brat. You’ve got a mouth on you.”
findings.current: “Heh heh. What a boy. Your tongue is too short.”
findings.defect: 혀가 짧구나 is a register jab at a mouthy junior, not a literal short tongue; the calque is opaque.
findings.rationale: Natural English should carry impertinence, not a body measurement, unless a preserved pun requires the literal.
findings.source: “허허, 그놈 참. 어린 녀석이 혀가 짧구나.”

summary: Two scene facts are wrong: survivors actively deflecting the stone volley become passive victims, and the encircling-formation order is rendered as dispersal. Several register/action cues are also off (feigned calm, the chili euphemism, scruff vs neck, added deus-ex framing, lost 따위 contempt).
